description: This file is the main program/setup for a .NET backend API service for data asset management. It configures services, middleware, and various API endpoints related to assets, including CRUD operations, copying, lineage, validation, reporting, health checks, and Swagger/OpenAPI documentation.

classes.name: HealthRootResponse
classes.description: Response object indicating the health status of the service.

classes.name: HealthzResponse
classes.description: Response object for detailed health status including database connectivity.

classes.name: DevLoginRequest
classes.description: Payload for dev login endpoint to generate JWTs for testing.

classes.name: DevLoginResponse
classes.description: Response object containing the generated JWT and related info.

classes.name: JwtTokenService
classes.description: Service responsible for creating JWT tokens.

classes.name: DatabaseConfigProvider
classes.description: Provides and normalizes database connection strings from environment variables.

classes.name: InMemoryIdempotencyStore
classes.description: Simple in-memory store for managing idempotency keys.
